jobs.title: AVP, CXO Strategy & Transformation
jobs.description:
You are as unique as your background, experience and point of view. Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered and challenged to be your best self. You'll work with dynamic colleagues - experts in their fields - who are eager to share their knowledge with you. Your leaders will inspire and help you reach your potential and soar to new heights. Every day, you'll have new and exciting opportunities to make life brighter for our Clients - who are at the heart of everything we do.

At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.

When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives.

Discover how you can make a difference in the lives of individuals, families and communities around the world.

Job Description:

Role Summary

Reporting to the Vice-President, Experience, Planning and Transformation, CXO, the AVP, CXO Strategy & Transformation will help drive the development and stewardship of an integrated CXO vision and Client platform strategy and execution within CXO and across SL Canada.

This role will act as a senior strategic integrator across the CXO mandate—bringing together strategy, transformation, performance reporting, analytics, to tell a cohesive story. The successful candidate will help build insights discipline, and change capability required to simplify how CXO works, sharpen decision-making, and ensure investments are clearly linked to client, advisor, sponsor, business, risk, and financial outcomes.

The role requires a strong mix of strategic thinking, business management, financial and analytical acumen, executive-level communication and pragmatic execution. The candidate will be expected to work closely with CXO leadership, Canadian business partners, Finance, Technology, and Global partners, and senior stakeholders to develop a cohesive CXO-wide narrative, strengthen performance management, programmatically manage spend and priorities, and ensure the function is operating with appropriate risk, auditability, and governance standards.

This is a high-impact role for a proven strategy and transformation leader who can connect the dots across complex domains, turn data into insight, create structure from ambiguity, and help move a large, multi-disciplinary function from reporting activity to driving measurable action.

What will you do?

Shape and steward the Client Experience Office strategy and transformation agenda, connecting priorities across client experience, engagement, digital, marketing, data and business partners.
Build the transformation capability and operating disciplines needed to move strategy into execution, including governance, prioritization, metrics, decision forums and management routines.
Lead an insight-driven performance approach, partnering with Data and Finance to connect business, client, financial, operational and risk information to executive decision-making.
Modernize performance management and executive reporting, creating monthly and quarterly business reviews that clearly connect strategy, investments, initiatives, outcomes, risks, dependencies and decisions.
Guide portfolio and investment prioritization, helping ensure resources and spend are aligned to strategic priorities, client and business outcomes, sales enablement and risk reduction.
Develop executive-level strategic narratives and recommendations for senior leadership and Board-level audiences, simplifying complex issues and clearly articulating progress, trade-offs, risks and required decisions.
Advance the Client Experience Office’s AI strategy, helping leaders determine appropriate areas for investment, experimentation, capability development and leadership attention.
Lead through influence across a complex matrix, partnering with Finance, Technology, Data, Digital, Marketing, Operations, Risk and business leaders to strengthen alignment, simplify ways of working and accelerate execution.

What you’ll need to succeed?

10+ years of progressive experience in strategy, transformation, business management, consulting, financial services, client experience, operations, technology enablement or related corporate leadership roles.
Demonstrated experience leading or supporting enterprise transformation, strategic planning, portfolio management, executive governance or performance management.
Experience working with senior executives and senior governance forums, including the development of concise, decision-oriented executive and Board materials.
Ability to translate complex business, financial, technology, risk and client information into clear strategic recommendations and executive narratives.
Experience designing or improving performance-management frameworks, business reviews, scorecards, dashboards or executive reporting.
Strong financial and analytical capability, including experience interpreting cost structures, investment trade-offs, technology spend, operational metrics and business performance.
Demonstrated success partnering across Technology, Finance, Data, Digital, Marketing, Operations, Risk and business teams within a complex, matrixed organization.
Experience leading teams, developing talent and improving operating models or ways of working.
Strategic problem solving and the ability to identify the implications behind quantitative and qualitative information.
Sound judgment and the ability to prioritize opportunities based on business value, feasibility and risk.
A pragmatic, action-oriented approach to moving complex initiatives from strategy through execution.
Clear, concise executive communication and the ability to influence across functions and levels.
Collaborative leadership with a commitment to coaching and developing others.

What's in it for you?

A competitive salary and bonus program, based on market scale
A flexible group insurance program starting on your first day of work to meet your needs and those of your family.
Our Share Ownership Program gives you the opportunity to invest in Sun Life while benefiting from employer matching contributions.
We are proud to be included in Great Place to Work's 2026 list of Canada's Best Workplaces.

The Base Pay range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. It may vary depending on the work location of the successful candidate or other factors. In addition to Base Pay, eligible Sun Life employees participate in various incentive plans, payment under which is discretionary and subject to individual and company performance. Certain sales focused roles have sales incentive plans based on individual or group sales results.

Diversity and inclusion have always been at the core of our values at Sun Life. A diverse workforce with wide perspectives and creative ideas benefits our Clients, the communities where we operate and all of us as colleagues. We welcome applications from qualified individuals from all backgrounds.

Persons with disabilities who need accommodation in the application process, or those needing job postings in an alternative format, may e-mail a request to thebrightside@sunlife.com.

We are proud to be a hybrid organization that offers our employees the choice and flexibility to work from both the office and virtually based on the needs of the business, our Clients and you.

We may use artificial intelligence to support candidate sourcing, screening, interview scheduling.

We thank all applicants for showing an interest in this position. Only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Job Description

Director, Measurement & Analytics

About Flywheel

Flywheel’s suite of digital commerce solutions accelerate growth across all major digital marketplaces for the world’s leading brands. We give clients access to near real-time performance measurement and improve sales, share, and profit. With teams across the Americas, Europe and APAC, we offer a career with real impact, endless growth opportunities and the support you need to be the best you can be.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a director to support and contribute to our Measurement & Analytics (M&A) team. Reporting to the Senior Director of the M&A consulting practice within Flywheel’s Commerce Intelligence team, you will play a key role in providing internal and external teams with campaign tracking solutions, reporting, and insights that transforms data into actionable business strategies. As a hands-on leader, you will collaborate with cross functional teams, manage client engagements for the world’s leading brands, and contribute to the development of innovative solutions and strategic analysis for client stakeholders.

What You Will Do

Lead and contribute to the delivery of client projects and engagements, ensuring high-quality outputs and actionable insights and recommendations that align with client objectives
Plan, develop and implement analytical frameworks, measurement strategies, and reporting solutions within Business Intelligence tools to support clients' business goals
Provide strategy recommendations, statistical modelling and analytics, test and learn frameworks, and convert insights into actions in collaboration with other team members
Collaborate with senior executives and a wide variety of internal and external stakeholders to identify business challenges and strategic opportunities where analytics can provide value spanning from web and merchandising analytics, media performance, customer lifetime value, and pricing and promotion optimization
Participate in responding to clients’ requests for proposal and presenting Commerce Intelligence capabilities
Lead, grow, and develop an analytics team and mentor broader team members providing training, guidance, and fostering a collaborative culture of analytical excellence
Stay informed about industry best practices, trends, and emerging technologies and contribute to the evolution of the team’s analytical approaches and continuous improvement of processes
Assist in executing the strategic vision for the Measurement & Analytics consulting practice, including supporting service offerings, methodologies, thought leadership content, and growth initiatives
Build and maintain strong relationships with client stakeholders, acting as a trusted advisor on commerce and analytics strategies

Who You Are

Strong experience with learning agendas, hypothesis testing, A/B testing, experimental design, and building road maps
5-7 years’ experience with direct-to-consumer/ eCommerce business reporting, insights, and analysis
Strong experience with data manipulation, visualizations and dashboarding with tools such as Google Data Studio, Tableau, PowerBI, and/ or DOMO reporting suites
Solid understanding of digital advertising, ad servers, and creative tagging; Experience with rich media technologies, real-time bidding, ad exchanges, and 3rd party ad servers such as Google DCM, Atlas, Mediaplex, Mediamind, etc.
Working knowledge of Google Analytics, Adobe Omniture, Crazy Egg, Moz, or other digital/site analytics[EH1.1]
Agency or client-side experience
A self-starter who moves quickly and independently on initiatives without extensive guidance and supervision
Proactively looks ahead and anticipates business needs and makes necessary pivots. Comfortable with change and evolving circumstances.
Strong communication and presentation skills as well as able to develop strong relationships with clients and internal stakeholders and manage expectations.
Creative problem-solving skills and strong attention to detail
Proven project management skills and quality assurance discipline

Working at Flywheel

We are proud to offer all Flywheelers a competitive rewards package and unparalleled career growth opportunities and a supportive, fun and engaging culture.

The Interview Process

Every role starts the same, an introductory call with someone from our Talent Acquisition team. We will be looking for company and values-fit as well as your professional experience; there may be some technical role-specific questions during this call.

Every role is different after the initial call, but you can expect to meet several people from the team 1:1 and there might be further skill assessments in the form of a Take Home Assignment/Case Study Presentation or Pair Programming/Live Coding exercise depending on the role. In your initial call, we will walk you through exactly what to expect the process to be.

Inclusive Workforce

At Flywheel, our goal is to create a culture where individuals of all backgrounds feel comfortable in bringing their authentic selves to work. We want all Flywheel people to feel included and truly empowered to contribute fully to our vision and goals.

Flywheel is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E-Verify. Everyone who applies will receive fair consideration for employment. We do not discriminate based upon race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.

If you have any accessibility requirements that would make you more comfortable during the application and interview process, please let us know at recruitment@flywheeldigital.com so that we can support you.

Please note, We do not accept unsolicited resumes.

salary range $150,000 - $175,000

Job Description:

Role Summary

The Director, Domain Enterprise Architect (Artificial Intelligence - AI) is accountable for the enterprise AI architecture domain, ensuring all AI, Generative AI, Agentic AI, machine intelligence, and intelligent automation investments across global operations align to a coherent strategic vision.

This leader establishes the enterprise AI domain strategy, target-state architecture, standards, roadmaps, governance frameworks, reference architectures, and investment priorities required to scale AI responsibly across the organization.

The Director functions as the senior architecture authority for AI, partnering closely with business executives, enterprise architects, platform leaders, risk functions, and technology teams to ensure AI investments are coordinated, reusable, governed, and strategically aligned.

This role balances long-term strategic planning with strong execution leadership, ensuring the enterprise AI roadmap translates into measurable business outcomes while maintaining regulatory compliance, operational excellence, and architectural consistency.

What will you do?

Enterprise AI Domain Strategy

Define and maintain the enterprise AI architecture strategy.
Establish target-state AI domain architecture and multi-year roadmaps.
Create AI reference models, standards, principles, policies, and guardrails.
Ensure AI strategy aligns with enterprise business strategy, technology strategy, and operating model.

Enterprise Investment Alignment

Establish visibility into AI investments across global business units.
Identify duplication, fragmentation, risk, and technology overlap.
Drive enterprise-wide reuse and strategic consolidation of AI capabilities.
Guide investment decisions toward scalable enterprise platforms and services.

Domain Governance & Standards

Own enterprise AI standards, approved technologies, architecture patterns, and reference architectures.
Chair and influence governance forums related to AI architecture decisions.
Evolve enterprise controls governing AI deployment, autonomy, human oversight, security, risk, and compliance.
Oversee exception management and architecture decision processes.

AI Portfolio & Roadmap Leadership

Develop centralized AI roadmaps supporting business capabilities and strategic priorities.
Coordinate roadmap activities across business groups and technology organizations.
Ensure foundational AI investments support future enterprise demand.
Assess emerging technologies and define adoption strategies.

Executive Engagement

Serve as the trusted advisor to executives regarding AI strategy and investment planning.
Communicate AI opportunities, risks, and architectural direction.
Facilitate strategic alignment between business leaders and technology organizations.
Present architecture recommendations to leadership and governance bodies.

Responsible AI & Regulatory Oversight

Establish enterprise Responsible AI architecture principles.
Ensure AI initiatives comply with regulatory expectations, model governance requirements, privacy obligations, and risk frameworks.
Drive transparency, explainability, accountability, and human oversight standards.
Partner with Risk, Security, Compliance, Legal, and Data leaders to mature enterprise AI governance.

Capability Development

Build and mentor a high-performing AI architecture community.
Develop AI architecture practices, methodologies, and knowledge-sharing programs.
Support Solution Architects and other Domain Architects in adopting enterprise standards.
Foster innovation while maintaining governance and execution discipline.

Value Realization

Define measures supporting AI investment value realization.
Track enterprise outcomes and adoption trends.
Ensure strategic AI initiatives generate measurable business value.
Continuously evolve roadmaps based on outcomes and feedback.

Success Measures

Well-defined and widely adopted enterprise AI strategy and roadmap.
Reduction of redundant AI investments and technology fragmentation.
Strong alignment of AI initiatives to business priorities and enterprise standards.
Effective governance and regulatory compliance across AI initiatives.
Increased adoption of approved enterprise AI capabilities.
Demonstrated business value from AI investments.
High confidence from executives, business leaders, and technology stakeholders.
Strong execution against roadmap commitments and strategic objectives.

What do you need to succeed?

Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related field.
Master's degree preferred.
Advanced architecture certifications preferred.
AI-specific certifications highly desirable.

Experience

10+ years of architecture leadership experience.
5+ years leading enterprise AI, data, analytics, digital transformation, or emerging technology domains.
Proven experience defining enterprise technology strategies and roadmaps.
Experience influencing senior executives and large-scale investment decisions.
Experience within highly regulated industries, preferably insurance, wealth management, banking, or financial services.
Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-wide architecture programs and governance functions.

Skills

Strategic AI Leadership: Deep expertise in Generative AI, Agentic AI, automation, large language models, AI platforms, orchestration frameworks, and enterprise AI operating models.
Enterprise Thinking: Strong understanding of architecture governance, roadmaps, standards management, risk, security, and business capability planning.
Influence & Executive Presence: Exceptional executive communication capability, strong facilitation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
Organizational Excellence: Highly organized and execution-focused, with strong planning, prioritization, and governance management skills.
Business Acumen: Ability to connect AI investments directly to business outcomes, productivity gains, client experience improvements, operational efficiency, and risk reduction.

What’s in it for you?

A competitive salary and bonus program, based on market scale
A flexible group insurance program starting on your first day of work to meet your needs and those of your family.
Time off that allows you to focus on the moments that matter most. 20 vacation days per year.
Our Share Ownership Program gives you the opportunity to invest in Sun Life while benefiting from employer matching contributions.
We are proud to be included in Great Place to Work's 2026 list of Canada's Best Workplaces.
A warm, supportive, and inclusive culture.
